title: Create your first Canva mobile video

scenes.title: START A CANVA VIDEO
scenes.caption: Open Canva and start a vertical video.
scenes.narration: Open Canva and start a new vertical video design. This is where your tutorial begins.

scenes.title: ADD YOUR VISUALS
scenes.caption: Upload the screenshots and clips you need.
scenes.narration: Upload the screenshots and clips you prepared. Choose clear images and keep personal details out of frame.

scenes.title: ARRANGE YOUR STORY
scenes.caption: Place each visual in the right order.
scenes.narration: Arrange the screenshots in the order viewers should follow. One clear action per scene works best.

scenes.title: ADD TEXT AND TITLES
scenes.caption: Use short titles and readable captions.
scenes.narration: Add a short title and a simple caption. Keep text large, high contrast, and away from screen edges.

scenes.title: ADD VOICE AND SOUND
scenes.caption: Add narration and a quiet sound bed.
scenes.narration: Record or add a voiceover to guide each step. Keep background music subtle so your words stay clear.

scenes.title: EXPORT YOUR VIDEO
scenes.caption: Choose vertical 9:16 and export in HD.
scenes.narration: Check the vertical nine by sixteen frame, preview the full edit, then export and review it before publishing.
